news.title: UNI teaching alums recognized with 2026 Yager Exemplary Teaching Award
news.summary_en: Two UNI teaching alumni earned recognition for their service to the education field when they recently received the University of Northern Iowa Dr. Robert E. and Phyllis M. Yager Exemplary Teaching Recognition Award.

news.title: Board of Regents approves new 3-year degree at UNI
news.summary_en: It will be UNI’s first 90-credit bachelor's degree, planned to launch in August 2027, pending approval from the Higher Learning Commission.

news.title: A “major” decision: Guiding your teen’s career exploration before college
news.summary_en: As a parent, you can guide your teen toward a career marked by purpose. Here are some tips to help your teen who might be asking "How do I choose a major?"

news.title: UNI Physics students present at international conference
news.summary_en: Four undergraduate students from the UNI Department of Physics presented their work at the 71st Annual Conference on Magnetism and Magnetic Materials in Hawaii. The conference brings together thousands of researchers, educators and students from around the world to share the latest scientific discoveries and technological advances.

news.title: UNI named a 2026 Best for Vets college
news.summary_en: The Best for Vets: Colleges recognition affirms UNI’s commitment to supporting military-connected students from the time they apply all the way through graduation.

news.title: Growing connection and Panther Pride in Story County
news.summary_en: In the heart of Story County, Iowa, patrons have been coming to Berry Patch Farm in Nevada for more than 50 years to pick their own fresh prodcue. Owners Joe and Kristin Wakeman both attended UNI and frequently connect with visitors on Panther Pride.

news.title: Building real-world tech skills: New $294K grant transforms UNI computer science learning
news.summary_en: A $294,000 grant from the Roy J. Carver Charitable Trust is helping UNI’s Department of Computer Science create state-of-the-art virtual computing environments where students can gain hands-on experience in cybersecurity, networking, system administration and more.
